findings.problem: The public stdin installer could not resolve its repository channel contract and exited before dry-run.
findings.rootCause: BASH_SOURCE and a checkout-relative file were treated as available in piped execution.
findings.fix: Use a fixed HTTPS channel-contract bootstrap only when a local contract is unavailable; validate schema and refs, clean temporary files, and cover success and failure paths.

findings.problem: The scheduled macOS workflow failed at pip --user before any Kacha check.
findings.rootCause: The runner uses externally managed Homebrew Python.
findings.fix: Install Python tools into RUNNER_TEMP venv and publish its bin path to later steps; local YAML and gate checks pass, post-push macOS execution remains separate evidence.

findings.problem: Every Studio bootstrap rebuilt immutable registries and took 8.5 to 11.6 seconds.
findings.rootCause: Catalog and font discovery had no process-level reuse and readiness preceded warmup.
findings.fix: Prewarm before listen, cache immutable catalog/font discovery, clone returned data, retain live custom styles and bind project-font invalidation to file metadata.

findings.problem: Oversized JSON destroyed the socket and non-object roots crossed the HTTP parser boundary.
findings.rootCause: Byte limits, parsing and HTTP status semantics were coupled to request.destroy().
findings.fix: Introduce typed 400/413 errors, byte-safe buffering, object-root validation and finite server timeouts; integration regression proves post-error health.

findings.problem: README, site and actual regression/catalog counts disagreed.
findings.rootCause: Current product facts were duplicated manually.
findings.fix: Derive 159 tests, 65 templates, 69 design entries, 23 core resources and 132 effects, then fail check-static when canonical surfaces drift.

findings.problem: The English page document root declared zh-CN.
findings.rootCause: One shared root layout owned both locales.
findings.fix: Use two static route-group root layouts and verify normal and GitHub Pages output.

findings.problem: The acquisition command silently selected canary while stable remained v1.1.0.
findings.rootCause: Channel selection was implicit in installer defaults and absent from public copy.
findings.fix: Pass --channel canary explicitly and document stable/canary semantics in Chinese and English.

findings.problem: Engineering checks and GitHub traffic could be mistaken for activation, value or retention.
findings.rootCause: No privacy-conscious adoption and outcome measurement contract existed.
findings.fix: Define separate engineering, activation, candidate, human-quality, efficiency, retention and economics metrics without adding third-party tracking; all real outcome values remain unknown.

findings.problem: The install copy action had no completion or failure state when Clipboard API remained pending.
findings.rootCause: The click handler awaited one browser API without a timeout or fallback.
findings.fix: Add bounded Clipboard API use, legacy local fallback and localized live success/failure feedback; verify the timeout fallback in Chromium.

findings.problem: Editor resize before opening a Timeline read projection.output from an empty state.
findings.rootCause: The overlay renderer assumed a loaded project while a global resize listener can run at any time.
findings.fix: Size and clear the layer, then return when projection is absent; add the guard to the workbench regression and repeat console-clean browser checks.

findings.problem: Changing design-system implementation code correctly invalidated the approved example styleframe and four positive regressions.
findings.rootCause: The approved artifact intentionally binds design and implementation digests, but the implementation change had not regenerated it.
findings.fix: Regenerate the styleframe and manifest with current code and rebind the edit-plan artifact SHA values.

findings.problem: A directory-only font-cache key could miss replacement of an existing font file.
findings.rootCause: Directory mtime is not guaranteed to change for in-place file content replacement.
findings.fix: Include sorted font filename, size, mtime and ctime metadata and bound retained cache keys to eight.

findings.problem: vinext 0.0.50 carries a development-only image-size advisory chain.
findings.rootCause: The available fix is vinext 1.0.0-beta.8 with a semver-major and peer-dependency migration.
findings.fix: Keep production vulnerability count at zero and fail on any exception drift; schedule the beta compatibility migration as a separate reviewed iteration.

decision: All locally solvable findings in the frozen plan are implemented and producer-reviewed, and the second full regression is recorded separately. Remote installer, macOS workflow, Pages readback and dual-agent deployment remain post-push delivery gates. Independent final review and real creator outcomes remain open and are not self-approved.
